subject.title: Himalaya skill: missing email formatting philosophy and incorrect command syntax

question: Should the Himalaya guidance be repaired in the bundled skill, or should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95132 remove it from core and move ongoing maintenance to a ClawHub skill?
rationale: Both paths are technically viable, but implementing either before maintainers choose the permanent owner risks duplicate or discarded documentation and conflicting expectations about bundled optional skills.

options.title: Externalize with the starter-set trim
options.body: Land the removal direction and carry corrected CLI, composition, install, update, and smoke-proof guidance in a maintained ClawHub skill.

options.title: Retain and repair the bundled skill
options.body: Keep Himalaya in core and land a focused upstream-verified documentation update covering the command errors and intentionally approved composition caveats.

recommendation.title: Externalize with the starter-set trim
recommendation.body: Land the removal direction and carry corrected CLI, composition, install, update, and smoke-proof guidance in a maintained ClawHub skill.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent skill-relocation and ClawHub work plus the starter-set discussion provide the strongest available ownership trail for this boundary decision.
